brief:
Israeli occupation forces released 35 prisoners from Gaza on Sunday, according to Shehab Wire. The releases marked another step in the exchange of detainees held by Israel and Palestinian factions.

The identities of the freed prisoners and the specific circumstances of their release remain undisclosed. No statement was immediately issued regarding whether the releases followed negotiations or corresponded to an existing agreement between the parties.

title: Israel releases 35 prisoners from Gaza
